'''Yannick Lapointe LS''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-18148">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18148 DeckTech post 18148], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 8 August 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18148/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18148/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

The post also lists 2x grabbler, which matches no known card; it is shown as posted and counted in the published total.
